# watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule (Data Source)

Looks up a single SGL alert rule by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_sgl_alert_rule" "example" {
  name = "High Error Rate"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the SGL alert rule to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) SGL alert rule ID.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled.
- `severity` (String) Severity raised on a breach.
